translations.web: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
translations.bsb: So He said, “A man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return.
translations.kjv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
